result.instructions: Tools for Oases, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Look up the student record for id 1920 and show its grade and status."; "List the notes on the parent with id 2259."; "Show the states and grades reference lists.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Oases data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run oases_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run oases_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run oases_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. oases_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: oases_get_student
tools.title: Get a student
tools.description: Get one student record by id. Oases API: GET /v2/student/{id}.

tools.name: oases_get_parent
tools.title: Get a parent
tools.description: Get one parent record by id. Oases API: GET /v2/parent/{id}.

tools.name: oases_get_staff
tools.title: Get a staff member
tools.description: Get one staff member record (tutor or staff) by id. Oases API: GET /v2/staff/{id}.

tools.name: oases_get_session
tools.title: Get a session
tools.description: Get one tutoring session record by id. Oases API: GET /v2/session/{id}.

tools.name: oases_get_invoice
tools.title: Get an invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice by id, with its line items. Oases API: GET /v2/invoice/{id}.

tools.name: oases_get_payment
tools.title: Get a payment
tools.description: Get one payment record by id. Oases API: GET /v2/payment/{id}.

tools.name: oases_get_notes
tools.title: Get notes
tools.description: List the notes on one student, parent or tutor, or schedule. Oases API: GET /v2/note/{note_type}/{note_parent}.

note_type.description: Record type of the note parent: 1 = student, 2 = tutor or parent, 5 = schedule.

note_parent.description: The note parent (student, parent, tutor or schedule) id (numeric).

tools.name: oases_get_list
tools.title: Get a reference list
tools.description: Read one reference list, such as states, schools, grades, session types or custom fields. Oases API: GET /v2/lists/{name}.

tools.name: oases_create_note
tools.title: Create a note
tools.description: Add a note to a student, parent or tutor, or schedule. This creates a new record each time it runs. Oases API: PUT /v2/note (form data).

note_type.description: Record type of the note parent: 1 = student, 2 = tutor or parent, 5 = schedule.

note_parent.description: The note parent (student, parent, tutor or schedule) id (numeric).

note_date.description: Date and time of the note, for example 2026-11-10 09:30:00.

note_owner.description: Name of the person who writes the note.

note_category.description: Category: PH = phone call, MTG = meeting, OB = onboarding, OTH = other, AUD = audit.

tools.name: oases_update_student
tools.title: Update a student field
tools.description: Change one field of a student record. Oases API: POST /v2/student/{id} with fieldname and value.

fieldname.description: The record field to change, as Oases names it.

value.description: The new value for the field.

tools.name: oases_update_parent
tools.title: Update a parent field
tools.description: Change one field of a parent record. Oases API: POST /v2/parent/{id} with fieldname and value.

fieldname.description: The record field to change, as Oases names it.

value.description: The new value for the field.
